title: Financial Contagion Networks as Annealing-Ready Ising Systems Cascades, Bailout Optimization, and Susceptibility
abstract: arXiv:2609.17415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interconnected financial systems are vulnerable to cascading failures arising from cross-holdings and nonlinear contagion, making the analysis and mitigation of systemic risk a challenging computational problem. In this work, we develop a unified optimization framework for financial network analysis based on Ising models and Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO). Starting from the Elliott Golub Jackson financial network model, we extend equilibrium valuation to incorporate threshold-induced failures, formulate the Maximum Cascade Failure Problem, and derive an equivalent QUBO representation. We then formulate the Optimal Bailout Allocation Problem as a controlled Ising model and transform the resulting bi-level optimization into a single joint QUBO that simultaneously determines equilibrium failures and optimal interventions under budget constraints. translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.17415v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：相互关联的金融系统容易因交叉持股和非线性传染而引发级联失效，这使得系统性风险的分析与缓解成为一个具有挑战性的计算问题。在本工作中，我们基于伊辛模型（Ising models）和二次无约束二元优化（QUBO），为金融网络分析开发了一个统一的优化框架。从 Elliott-Golub-Jackson 金融网络模型出发，我们将均衡估值进行扩展以纳入由阈值引发的失效，提出了最大级联失效问题，并推导出其等价的 QUBO 表示。随后，我们将最优救助分配问题表述为一个受控伊辛模型，并将由此产生的双层优化转化为单一的联合 QUBO，从而在预算约束下同时确定均衡失效状态与最优干预措施。为了刻画单个机构的影响力，我们引入了 ba……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将金融传染网络建模为适合（量子）退火求解的伊辛系统，提出基于QUBO的统一优化框架，将最大级联失效识别与预算约束下的最优救助分配这一双层优化问题转化为单一联合QUBO形式，为系统性风险的分析与缓解提供了全新的计算范式。
en_tdlr: This paper models financial contagion networks as annealing-ready Ising systems, formulating maximum cascade failure identification and optimal bailout allocation as a single joint QUBO optimization framework, enabling systemic risk analysis and mitigation via (quantum) annealing.
